findings.note: NBA.com's last-five log shows Randle with 9 rebounds in 39 minutes at MIL on Nov 25 and 9 vs ORL on Nov 20. He topped 5.5 in 3 of his last 5 games, but had 4 at MIN and 0 vs CHI in a 27-minute blowout.

CBS/Rotowire lists Randle at 6.0 RPG in 33.1 MPG, slightly above the 5.5 line. A Nov 19 note says he averaged 3.6 boards over five games and flags his inconsistent rebounding and Brooklyn's frequent blowout losses. No injury news appeared in the search.
In the Oct 21 season opener against Charlotte, Randle had 33 points and 8 rebounds in 38 minutes. That is the only regular-season meeting between these teams so far, and he went over this line in it.
